N-add01#3.zh: 嘿！只要捉住王母，不怕王进不乖乖就范。
N-add01#3.t: Heh! Once we've got the old woman, Wang Jin will come quietly.

N-add01#4.zh: 呵呵！这会儿咱们可要立下大功了。
N-add01#4.t: Ha ha! We'll be rewarded handsomely for this one.

N-add01#6.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add01#8.zh: 失败条件二 --- 王进死亡

N-add01#9.zh: 失败条件二 --- 王母死亡

N-add01#10.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！
N-add01#10.t: The turn limit has run out with the mission unfinished. Game over!

N-add01#11.zh: 王母在混战之中被官兵所杀，悲愤的王进冲入敌阵，击毙数名官兵，后被乱刀砍死；%N奋力杀出敌阵，隔日遭官府全面通缉，从此亡命天涯........
N-add01#11.t: Wang's mother was killed in the melee. Mad with grief, Wang Jin charged the soldiers, struck down several, and was hacked to death. %N fought his way out, but was named an outlaw the very next day, and spent the rest of his life on the run........

N-add01#12.zh: 王进为救母亲，被官兵所包围，%N援救不及，王进被杀，王母也随之自尽，%N虽逃出生天，却每每自责其罪，三年后，抑郁而终，享年二十八岁..........
N-add01#12.t: Wang Jin was surrounded while trying to save his mother, and %N could not reach him in time. Wang Jin was killed, and his mother took her own life. %N escaped, but never forgave himself. Three years later he died of grief, aged twenty-eight..........

N-add01#13.zh: %N为官兵所擒杀，王进孤掌难鸣，终失手被擒，被解押回京，后在狱中为高俅所害........
N-add01#13.t: %N was captured and killed by the soldiers. Alone, Wang Jin could not hold out. He was taken, sent back to the capital in chains, and later murdered in prison by Gao Qiu........

N-add01#14.zh: 承蒙搭救，还未来得及请问壮士的大名？
N-add01#14.t: You've saved us, and I haven't even asked your name, friend.

N-add01#17.zh: 哈哈...没有想到我还那么出名。
N-add01#17.t: Ha ha... I didn't know I was that famous.

N-add01#18.zh: 江湖相传路见不平、拔刀相助的『%M』就是您？真是失敬失敬。
N-add01#18.t: The "%M" the rivers and lakes tell of, who draws his blade whenever he sees injustice? That's you? Forgive me for not recognising you.

N-add01#19.zh: 这没什么；我这个人就是好打抱不平，所以常常得罪官兵。对了，我听士兵提到高俅的名字。你是因为什么事得罪了高俅那厮？
N-add01#19.t: It's nothing. I just can't stand by when someone's being wronged, so I'm always in trouble with the soldiers. By the way, I heard them mention Gao Qiu. How did you fall foul of that scoundrel?

N-add01#20.zh: 唉...我名叫王进，原本是八十万禁军教头；前些日子新上任一位高太尉，我当是谁呢！原来是以前在东京的地痞高二！听说这个高二因为踢得一脚好球，所以改名高俅，跟在端王身边。后来端王被册立为天子，高俅也跟着发了。
N-add01#20.t: Ah... My name is Wang Jin. I was an instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards. Not long ago a new Marshal Gao took office, and who should it be but Gao Er, the old street rogue of the Eastern Capital! They say he kicked a fine game of football, changed his name to Gao Qiu, and attached himself to Prince Duan. When the prince was made Emperor, Gao Qiu rose with him.

N-add01#21.zh: 那么高俅为何要找你麻烦？
N-add01#21.t: And why would Gao Qiu come after you?

N-add01#22.zh: 他以前曾被我父亲一棒打倒，受了三四个月的重伤；今日是他发迹之时，正想要报仇泄恨；我想再继续待在他底下，一定会被他找机会整死！还不如走为上策，前去延安府投靠熟人...
N-add01#22.t: Years ago my father knocked him down with a staff, and he spent three or four months recovering. Now that he's risen, he wants his revenge. If I'd stayed under him, he'd have found a way to finish me. Better to leave, I thought, and go to friends in Yan'an...

N-add01#23.zh: 那日他当着众人骂我：『你爷是街市上使花棒卖药的，你省的甚么武艺！』回到家中，我娘只说了一句：『我儿，三十六着，走为上着。』
N-add01#23.t: That day he cursed me in front of everyone: "Your father sold medicine in the market twirling a staff for the crowds. What would you know of martial arts!" When I came home, my mother said only this: "My son, of the thirty-six stratagems, running away is the best."

N-add01#24.zh: 不过你现在伤势不轻，老夫人又饱受跋涉之苦；此处已出高俅管辖范围，不如暂时找一处地方休养，再往延安府不迟。
N-add01#24.t: But you're badly hurt, and your mother is worn out from the road. We're beyond Gao Qiu's reach here. Why not rest somewhere for a while? Yan'an can wait.

N-add01#26.zh: 经过一场恶战，王母终于逃脱了官兵的追捕。
N-add01#26.t: After a hard fight, Wang's mother finally escaped the soldiers.
